page_title: MON 1-1 LEC | Monza v Lecce 17/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) wins himself enough space to connect with a cross inside the box, but his fine header goes narrowly over the crossbar!
90+4' Corner kick. Monza will have an opportunity.
90+1' Ahmed Touba (Lecce) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
90' The fourth official shows 9 min. of added time.
89' Good work from Monza as they win a corner.
89' Substitution. Patrick Ciurria makes his way off the pitch and Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) comes on as his replacement.
87' Pedro Pereira (Monza) has tested the patience of referee Livio Marinelli and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
85' Luca Caldirola (Monza) should have been more careful. He commits a bad foul, receives his second yellow card and is sent-off!
84' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Monza will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
83' The ball is out of play and Monza manage to earn a corner.
81' Good team movement sets up Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post.
80' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
78' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to substitute Pontus Almqvist and he is replaced by Ahmed Touba (Lecce).
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) replaces Nikola Krstovic.
76' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Livio Marinelli had an easy-decision to make.
76' Now Monza have a corner.

76' Andrea Carboni (Monza) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the right post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out. The linesman points to the corner flag, Monza are going to take it.
74' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) replacing Lameck Banda.
74' That's the end of the game for Antonino Gallo, who is replaced by Patrick Dorgu (Lecce).
72' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Monza due to an offside in the build-up play.
71' The Monza players halt their celebrations as referee Livio Marinelli makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
69' GOAL! Great reaction there from Andrea Carboni (Monza), who acrobatically contorts his body to score inside the box from a rebound. It’s 2:1.
69' Dany Mota (Monza) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
68' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Monza.
67' Here is a change. Lorenzo Colombo is going off and Raffaele Palladino gives the last tactical orders to Pedro Pereira (Monza).
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Samuele Birindelli departs the field of play to be replaced by Mirko Maric (Monza).
64' Lameck Banda (Lecce) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
62' Looks like Lameck Banda (Lecce) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
61' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Samuele Birindelli (Monza) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
58' The ref’s original red card decision for Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) is upheld after a VAR review!

55' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Federico Baschirotto (Lecce), but referee Livio Marinelli must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
55' Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) makes an ugly tackle on his opponent and is sent off by the referee!
54' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to make a change. Alexis Blin (Lecce) replaces Hamza Rafia.
52' Andrea Colpani (Monza) gets there first and whips in a shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post.
51' Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.

50' Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Livio Marinelli blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
49' Armando Izzo (Monza) brings his opponent down. Livio Marinelli has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.

46' A precise low pass is received by Roberto Gagliardini (Monza), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
46' Raffaele Palladino has made a change at the break. Andrea Carboni has come on in place of Pablo Mari (Monza).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Livio Marinelli shows a yellow card to Hamza Rafia (Lecce) for his blatant foul.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
43' Lameck Banda (Lecce) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom right corner, but Alessandro Sorrentino is equal to it and makes an easy save.
43' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
40' Lecce quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
38' Pablo Mari (Monza) brings an opponent down and Livio Marinelli interrupts the game.
38' Andrea Colpani (Monza) takes the corner.
38' An attempted cross from Patrick Ciurria (Monza) is cleared. Monza have been awarded a corner kick.
35' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Livio Marinelli blows for a foul.
32' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
30' Lorenzo Colombo (Monza) misses a great chance after he found some space in the box! His effort goes inches wide of the left post.
28' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
28' Andrea Colpani (Monza) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
27' Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The ball goes out of play. Monza are awarded a corner kick.
26' Dany Mota (Monza) comes onto the pitch because Gianluca Caprari simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
25' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

24' 1 - 1 Goal! Lorenzo Colombo displays great vision and sends a pass to Andrea Colpani (Monza), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 1:1.
23' The Lecce players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
20' Pablo Mari (Monza) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
18' Armando Izzo (Monza) tackles a bit over-zealously and Livio Marinelli blows for a foul.
15' Pablo Mari (Monza) makes a rough challenge and Livio Marinelli blows his whistle for a foul.

14' Luca Caldirola (Monza) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the left post and behind for a goal kick. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
12' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Andrea Colpani (Monza) takes it short.
11' Pablo Mari (Monza) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. Monza force a corner. They send men into the box.
11' Andrea Colpani (Monza) will take the corner.
9' A clumsy foul by Hamza Rafia (Lecce) and Livio Marinelli blows his whistle.

5' What a chance that is! Samuele Birindelli (Monza) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
3' 0 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Alessandro Sorrentino no chance!
3' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Luca Caldirola (Monza) was quite harsh and Livio Marinelli didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
2' Luca Caldirola (Monza) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Livio Marinelli signals. Lecce are awarded a penalty! What an opportunity to score.
1' The Lecce players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' The match has just started.
Lecce will kick the game off.
Livio Marinelli will officiate today.
